title: Nassakeag (South Setauket)
summary: Nassakeag is connected with the southwest border of Setauket in Brookhaven town, in the locality later known as South Setauket. The name is tied both to a swamp and to Nassakeag, a Nissequogue sachem whose name appears in regional land records.
map_geometry_source: approximate South Setauket locality marker; not exact swamp boundary or residence coordinate
history_content: Nassakeag belongs to the Setauket, South Setauket, and Nissequogue regional landscape. Time-specific land and swamp-name evidence is handled through Historic Moments.
translation_content:
Recorded forms include Nassakeag, Nassekege, Nasseceage, Nesakaks swamp, Nasakakes swamp, Nasakeges swamp, and Naskeague. Tooker suggests the name may relate to being in the middle of a swamp, while also leaving open whether the swamp was named for the sachem or the sachem for the swamp.

Why Place Names Matter

“To name a place can simply be to index that location, but depending on the cultural context, naming a place can also convey the story, and any meanings that story can carry.”

— Katherine A. Roberts, Teaching Places and Teaching Place (2024), Article, paragraph beginning 'The names of the places are descriptive'
whereintheworld_content: The map placement is an approximate general point for South Setauket, not an exact swamp boundary or a precise location for Nassakeag's residence.
